footnote_text: Represents shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the "Common Stock"), of Silvia, Inc. (formerly known as ProCap Financial, Inc.) (the "Issuer") withheld by the Issuer to satisfy tax withholding obligations upon the settlement of 125,628 restricted stock units ("RSUs") that vested on July 6, 2026. After such withholding, 78,217 shares of Common Stock were delivered to the Reporting Person. || Consists of (i) 4,152,441 shares of Common Stock held directly, including 435,644 shares of Common Stock received by the Reporting Person in the merger of Silvia Merger Sub, Inc. with and into CFO Silvia, Inc. on April 6, 2026 and held in escrow for the benefit of the Reporting Person to secure indemnification obligations under the related merger agreement, which shares may not be transferred by the Reporting Person while so held, and (ii) 376,885 shares of Common Stock underlying unvested RSUs granted to the Reporting Person on May 19, 2026, which are scheduled to vest as follows: 125,628 RSUs on October 6, 2026; 125,628 RSUs on January 6, 2027; and 125,629 RSUs on April 6, 2027, in each case subject to the Reporting Person's continued service and the other terms of the award.
